pose: Directly facing the camera in a tall, upright 'pillar' stance. The snout is pointed forward with a friendly smirk, reaching the top edge of the 1024px frame. Its powerful arms are tucked slightly, showing off the large hand claws within the 300px horizontal safety zone. The tail is hidden directly behind the legs to keep the silhouette narrow for the 340x140px crop.
